scope: PARASHARI_HOUSE_LORD_V1: for a natal D1 chart under the PARASHARI_LAHIRI profile, each house's whole-sign sign, its classical lord, the lord's sign and whole-sign house, and each of the nine grahas' sign and whole-sign house. The module under certification is engine/parashari/house_lord.py.

rule.convention: whole-sign houses from the D1 Lagna (ADR-0133 D3), the seven classical sign lords

A_table_integrity.disclosure: the transcription is implementation-independent of engine/astrology/sign_lord.py (typed separately, never imported); it is not source-independent, since both follow the same classical lordship. Gate C adds PyJHora's table as an external reference.

B2_placement_composition.space: 12 Lagna signs x 12 target signs x 2 patterns (all grahas together; grahas spread five signs apart)
B2_placement_composition.disclosure: the spread pattern places every graha in a different sign, so a lord's house cannot be confused with another graha's

C_oracle.disclosure: a table-level oracle: PyJHora's lordship table, with each lord's house rebuilt from this project's own certified placements. PyJHora does not compute the charts here, so the astronomical substrate is not re-checked by this gate (it is Tier-0 certified).

D_independent_validator.note: separate-process reimplementation; derives sign, house and lordship itself, importing no engine.astrology module and not engine.parashari.house_lord for its own derivation

F_boundary_cases.convention: exact lower sign edges belong to the sign; the 360/0 wrap is not promoted; inherited from engine.astrology.signs.zodiac_sign, which SIGN_CONVENTION_V1 certifies

G_static_reference_regression.methodology: LIVE production house_lords() on fixed synthetic charts, against STATIC values frozen once from the independent validator's own derivation

controls.control: houses counted backwards from the Lagna
lord's house by equal houses from the Lagna degree
lord's house taken as the house it rules

H_negative_controls.exercises_note: compares planted corrupted copies with the real production output; the production module itself is corrupted only by gate I's monkeypatch self-check

I_composition_verification.scope: house_lords_from_snapshot() field by field on the validator's 8 synthetic charts, and a monkeypatch self-check: whole_sign_house arguments swapped, Scorpio given to Ketu, Aquarius given to Rahu, zodiac_sign off by one; each caught, and the module restored

refused: a Parashari-named snapshot with another ayanamsa

explicit_non_claims: certified support, not a production analytical input: no ratified entry serves it (ADR-0133 D5, PROPOSED)
the seven classical lords only: no Rahu or Ketu co-lordship of Scorpio or Aquarius
whole-sign houses only: no bhava-chalit, equal-house or cusp-based house
no strength, dignity, aspect, yoga or dasha
no interpretive or predictive claim: a house lord's placement is a calculated fact, never an indication
every chart used is synthetic; no real person's chart is certified
PyJHora is a table-level reference only; it computes no chart here

trust_records.residual_limitation: coordinated edits to every repository-held trust record cannot be cryptographically prevented by an in-repository trust anchor; only upstream provenance would anchor this, and it is out of M1 scope

justified_exceptions: Frozen holdout declarations and oracle imports are permitted only outside engine/; all scanned sources remain subject to suspicious-identifier detection.
